correctness.rationale: The D4 root vertex set ±ei±ej has 24 distinct roots, 96 dot-product-one edges and 24 supporting octahedral facets (8 coordinate and 16 signed-diagonal). Under D4 Weyl reflections any nonzero normal enters the chamber u1≥u2≥u3≥|u4|, with unique nonnegative coefficients on four rays. Root-height sign depends only on which ray coefficients vanish; 15 nonempty support masks collapse via D4 triality permuting outer rays (1,3,4) into precisely 7 classes (b,k). An independent exact-Fraction four-dimensional section implementation enumerated all 15 masks, incident segment crossings, rational edge-section vertices, all rank-two cell intersections, polygon sizes and Euler relation. All 7 asserted inventories reproduced: (12,24,14), (18,30,14), (26,42,18), (14,24,12), (20,32,14), (26,40,16), (32,48,18), with claimed triangle/quad/pentagon/hexagon compositions and two distinct 26-vertex types. Finite checks exhaust 15 masks because chamber sign constancy was established analytically; they do not merely sample the continuum.
